Package frc.DELib25.Subsystems.MotorSubsystems.CurrentTripDetectors

Class CurrentTripDetector

java.lang.Object
frc.DELib25.Subsystems.MotorSubsystems.CurrentTripDetectors.CurrentTripDetector
Direct Known Subclasses:
MagnitudeCurrentDetector, SpikeCurrentDetector
public abstract class CurrentTripDetector extends Object
Abstract current-trip detector with shared lifecycle: - Moving-average filtering (window in SAMPLES) - Startup ignore window (sec) - Debounce (sec) - Optional absolute timeout (sec) Usage: call initialize() once, then update(double) each cycle with the latest current sample (amps). If timeoutSeconds > 0, update() will return true once the timeout elapses (caller may treat as "give up/exit"). Note: movingAvgWindowSamples is in samples, not seconds. With a 20 ms loop, 10 samples ≈ 0.20 s.

    • CurrentTripDetector

      protected CurrentTripDetector(int movingAvgWindowSamples, double startupIgnoreSeconds, double debounceSeconds, double timeoutSeconds)
      Parameters:
      movingAvgWindowSamples - moving-average window length (>=1)
      startupIgnoreSeconds - ignore detection for the first X seconds after initialize()
      debounceSeconds - require the condition to persist this long before reporting true
      timeoutSeconds - optional max duration; invalid input: '<'=0 disables timeout
